name: Valley Indoor Swap Meet - Pomona
summary: Valley Indoor Swap Meet in Pomona is a bustling indoor marketplace featuring hundreds of vendors offering apparel, shoes, accessories, and services at value prices. Open daily with live music events and community activities, it serves as a popular shopping destination for bargain-hunting families throughout the Inland Empire.
demographics: Valley Indoor Swap Meet attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic primarily consisting of working-class families and bargain hunters from the Pomona and eastern Los Angeles County area. The visitor base skews toward Hispanic and multi-generational households with moderate to lower-middle income levels, drawn by the affordable pricing and variety of goods. Shoppers typically visit on weekends for both necessity purchases and leisure browsing, with many making it a family outing. The swap meet format appeals to budget-minded consumers seeking deals on apparel, accessories, household goods, and services not readily available at traditional retail centers.
description: Valley Indoor Swap Meet in Pomona is a vibrant one-stop shopping destination that has become a beloved community hub for bargain hunters and families throughout the Inland Empire. Housed in a spacious indoor facility at 1600 East Holt Avenue, this bustling marketplace features hundreds of independent vendors offering an eclectic mix of apparel, shoes, accessories, perfumes, household goods, and services under one roof. Open daily from 10am to 6pm (closed Tuesdays), the swap meet creates a lively atmosphere enhanced by regular live music performances from groups like Grupo Saborja and Valentin y Sus Teclados, as well as community events including food giveaways. Featured vendors like Beauty Venue with its extensive perfume collection, Lily's Jeans Fashion for women's apparel, Martini Men's Wear for casual menswear, and Estilo Malandron Hats showcase the diversity of offerings available. With low start-up costs, no security deposits or leases, and no common area fees, the swap meet provides an accessible platform for entrepreneurs while delivering exceptional value to shoppers seeking unique finds and unbeatable prices in a welcoming, family-friendly environment.
